entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕男成婚（西语 casarse el p.qs.，词尾残损，或为 'el primeiro/proprius' 类缩写，娶妻之义，具体所指不能定）
entries.en: 〔damaged entry〕for a man to marry (Sp. casarse, reflexive; abbreviated qualifier illegible)
entries.notes: 四栏中汉、闽、官话三栏皆空，西语词尾残损，仅能判定为男性婚娶义。

entries.zh: 娶（男子成婚）；小注另记'娶新妇'一类说法，原稿其下有删涂
entries.en: for a man to take a wife, to marry (of the male); marginal note records an alternate Hokkien phrase, partially struck through
entries.notes: 四栏互证明确（娶/chu he chu chin/chy），但闽语栏有删涂字迹且左栏小注残缺，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 嫁（女子出嫁，配与人）
entries.en: for a woman to marry, to be given in marriage (Sp. casarse la mujer)

entries.zh: 媒（说合婚姻之人）；冰媒、媒人之义
entries.en: matchmaker, go-between in marriage (Sp. casamiento, marriage-broker sense)
entries.notes: 汉字'媒'与 R 栏 mūey 清晰，但 L 栏后有不可辨上标小字，M 栏有一处污损（T99）及 ñ/in 存疑，降 medium。

entries.zh: 冰人（媒人的雅称，典出《晋书》；本页同义词条系列之一）
entries.en: 'ice man' — elegant/literary term for a matchmaker (from the classical allusion); matchmaker

entries.zh: 牽手（牵手，闽南语中夫妻互称、成婚结为之义）
entries.en: 'holding hands' — to join in marriage; in Hokkien also a term for spouse (khan-chhiú)

entries.zh: 娶某（男子娶妻；'某'为闽南语'妻子'之称，汉字存疑作某/山）
entries.en: for a man to take a wife (Hokkien: to marry one's 'boó', i.e. wife)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字存疑（某/山），但 M 栏 bou 与 R 栏 mon 均指向闽南语'某'（妻），义可定而字未定，降 medium。

entries.zh: 娶親（娶亲，男子迎娶成婚；首二字在原稿似有删涂）
entries.en: to take a wife, to marry (of the male; lit. 'to take a kin/bride')
entries.notes: 四栏互证一致，唯原稿首二字有删涂痕迹，降 medium。

entries.zh: 娶媳婦（男子娶媳成家）
entries.en: for a man to take a daughter-in-law, i.e. to marry a woman into the household; to take a wife
entries.notes: 汉字与 M 栏 hẽ sin pu 明确，R 栏 ie/ke 存疑（官话媳妇之'媳'），降 medium。

entries.zh: 嫁出（女子出嫁离去；末字 chun/chut 两读存疑）
entries.en: for a woman to be married off and leave her natal home (lit. 'marry out')
entries.notes: 义从汉字'嫁出'可定，但闽/官话两栏末音节拼写存疑，降 medium。

entries.zh: 嫁婿（女子嫁与夫家，招婿成婚；'婿'指夫婿/女婿）
entries.en: for a woman to marry, taking a husband/son-in-law (lit. 'marry the son-in-law')
entries.notes: 汉字'嫁婿'清晰而 M 栏 Lay（lai）与 R 栏 by 对应关系不甚直观，语义可从字面定，降 medium。

entries.zh: 暗相許（男女暗中私许婚约；西语疑为 a escondidas，即'偷偷地'私订终身）
entries.en: to betroth each other secretly, clandestine betrothal (Sp. prob. 'a escondidas', in secret)
entries.notes: 汉字'暗相許'与 M 栏 am sio hu 互证清晰；西语拼写 aespandidas/aescondidas 存疑但语义指向一致；R 栏首音 T99 污损。

entries.zh: 昵妻（亲近爱恋其妻；西语 casarse ala ueja，与老妇/己妻结合）
entries.en: to be intimate with one's wife (Sp. casarse ala ueja; ueja = vieja, one's wife/old woman in colloquial Spanish)
entries.notes: 汉字'昵妻'与 R 栏 ban chy（伴妻）相合；ueja 为 17 世纪口语 vieja（妻）之拼，释义依赖此推断，降 medium。

entries.zh: 嫁女子（父母嫁其女）
entries.en: for the parents to marry off their daughter (Sp. casar los padres a su hija)
entries.notes: 汉字与 M 栏 gue chau gia 互证明确；西语 p.es 为 padres 缩写（推断），R 栏残，降 medium。

entries.zh: 進贅（招赘：女家招男子入赘，婿就婚于女家）
entries.en: to take a husband into the wife's family by uxorilocal marriage (matrilocal/赘婚; Sp. 'marrying the daughter with the son-in-law coming into [her] house')

entries.zh: 改嫁（夫死之后妇人再嫁）
entries.en: for a widow to remarry (lit. 'changed marriage'; Sp. casarse la muger muerto el marido)

entries.zh: 再娶（男子妻死后再度娶妻；汉字再/冉存疑）
entries.en: for a widower to take a wife again, to remarry (of the male)
entries.notes: M/R 栏 chay chu/chy 与'再娶'互证清晰，唯汉字'再/冉'存疑、西语 biedos/biedro 拼写异常，降 medium。

entries.zh: 續娶（续弦：妻亡后续娶）
entries.en: to continue one's marriage by taking a new wife after the first died (续弦, remarry of a widower)
entries.notes: 汉字与语义清晰；M 栏 sio 与 R 栏 zog 对'續'的对应不一致（或 R 栏用官话字），有此歧点，降 medium。

entries.zh: 娶後姐仔（男子再娶，纳后续之妻；'後姐仔'即后妻、继室之称）
entries.en: to take a second wife, to marry a later wife (Hokkien: marry one's 'latter lady', i.e. subsequent wife; Sp. casar segunda vez)
entries.notes: 西语'再娶一次'明确，汉字'娶後姐仔'指纳继室；闽/官话两栏音节对应略参差，降 medium。

entries.zh: 同襟（连襟：两男子各娶姐妹为妻，互称连襟）
entries.en: brothers-in-law by marrying two sisters (co-brothers-in-law; Sp. two men marrying two sisters)

entries.zh: 完親（完亲，成婚、完婚）
entries.en: to complete the marriage, to be wed (lit. 'complete the kin-tie')

entries.zh: 做親（做亲，结亲成婚；M 栏 cho pu 或兼指'做妇/娶妇'）
entries.en: to form a marriage alliance, to be/get married (lit. 'make the kin-tie'; spouses joining together)
entries.notes: 汉字'做親'与 R 栏 cho gan（做婚/人）大体相合，但西语 Juntarse/Juritarse 存疑、M 栏 pu 与汉字'親'对应存异，降 medium。
